title: Agenda
description: A project's agenda (ADR 0058): the researcher's plan, which agents work from. Only the researcher writes it (the human listener); agents read it, and are told when it changed since they last read it.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

revision.description: Moves on every change; 0 for an agenda never written.

items.description: In order: an item's place among the items of its lane is its priority.

items.title: AgendaItem
items.description: One item of the agenda: a vault note (`note_id`) or a line of text (`text`), in a lane. Its place in the list is its order within its lane.

item_id.title: AgendaItemId
item_id.description: An agenda item's identifier: `note:<note-id>` for an item that is a vault note, `L<n>` for a line of the researcher's own text. Jobs and tasks name it as `agenda_item`.

lane.title: AgendaLane
lane.description: now: what agents should work on. next: what comes after. parked: do not spend on it for now. dropped: decided against, with a reason.

note_id.description: The vault note this item is (an item that is a note has no text).

text.description: The researcher's own line (an item that is not a note).

reason.description: Why it was dropped or parked, in the researcher's words.

added_at.title: Timestamp
added_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

moved_at.title: Timestamp
moved_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

items.title: AgendaRule
items.description: A standing instruction for every agent session of the project, in the researcher's words (`three seeds before anything is established`).

added_at.title: Timestamp
added_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

updated_at.title: Timestamp
updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

updated_by.title: ResearchActor
updated_by.description: Who made a change: a human session, an agent token or the system. Work under a task links the task (`task:ID`).

history.description: The last revisions, oldest first (the current one included), so a session is told what changed since the revision it last read.

items.title: AgendaRevision
items.description: The agenda as one revision left it.
